performance.method: Executed Thumb-1 instructions in ARM emulator, not device cycles. Production ELF, R4-R11/SP and bounded writes checked on every call. ROM CLZ/memory intrinsic internal instructions are not counted.
performance.scope: Group means on finite controlled inputs. Individual hard-to-round inputs can be slower because they require interval refinement or CORE-MATH. Qfplib trig comparison excludes arguments outside its documented ±1024 domain.

hardware_baseline.method: Both implementations in flash; identical input order, nine alternating paired batches, TIMERAWL, typed soft-float calls and matching calibration leaves. Interrupts enabled.
hardware_baseline.pause_reason: Coordinated short hardware handoff; keep acquired chunks and resume missing indexes later.
hardware_baseline.scope: Pre-Q70 math baseline, partial physical comparison. Instruction wins do not imply timing wins; sin/cos/tan/sqrt and one exp stream have confirmed timing deficits.

hardware_q70_v3.scope: Earlier Q70-only candidate; some sin/cos cases improve but ordinary sin/cos and tan still trail Qfplib. This is not a timing result for the later hybrid/table-compaction candidate.

hardware_tan_v3.scope: Tangent v3 bounded products and Q70 midpoint refinement, production source based on accepted 0.8.8/1660d7816. All six measured sin/cos streams beat Qfplib; tan ordinary/range and sqrt retain timing gaps. Both execute in flash.

hardware_tan_v5.conclusion: The 16-byte rational tangent rows reduce cache misses but their extra arithmetic makes ordinary tan slower than v3 and Qfplib. Do not select v5 on emulator counts alone. New sqrt register allocation still leaves hardware gaps.
hardware_tan_v5.instrumentation_note: First transaction stopped after seven complete chunks when one control hit count exceeded accesses by one. Fixed reset order (accesses before hits) makes accesses enclose hits; last five chunks use the fixed APP. Timing counters themselves are outside the timed interval.

hardware_v7_full.classification_limit: Raw group medians are not a significance test. The f2d difference is about 0.001 us and does not establish a meaningful gap.
hardware_v7_full.layout_limit: Adding Qfplib shifted owned read-only tables by 5888 bytes. These physical timings describe that diagnostic layout; they do not establish exact production-layout timings.

physical_snapshot.method: Both implementations in flash; identical input order, nine alternating paired batches, TIMERAWL, typed soft-float calls and matching calibration leaves. Interrupts enabled. XIP hit/access counters sampled outside timing; include both cores, with paired control counts recorded. Owned math addresses and bytes match production; Qfplib is isolated at 0x10180000. physical_snapshot.scope: Finite physical workloads. Lower group medians are not proof of a strict speedup for every input or interrupt/cache state. Normal f2d has13 executed instructions in each implementation and is effectively tied.

changes: Exp uses a compensated inline square and high product, enclosure 5 Q62 units, and an equivalent high-word segment selection saving 36 executed instructions.

Tan reuses the six-MUL Q70 cube and nine-MUL Q54 product, keeps the residual tail, and evaluates the fourth power with two MULs. Certified full/half/refined Q70 enclosures are 143/25/51 units; final output still requires unambiguous rounding or a more precise fallback.
Static RAM is unchanged. The Q94 sin/cos and Q70 tangent table bytes are unchanged; no additional coefficient table or SRAM cache is introduced.

benchmark_stability.observation: Before in-APP warm-up, initial log-normal Qfplib batches took about 9 us before dropping to about 7.4 us. A host-side 1000 ms pause alone did not eliminate the transient.
benchmark_stability.change: The frozen benchmark APP now runs both implementations for at least 1000000 us before collecting any of the nine alternating paired batches. All seven selected chunks verified that duration, with production math addresses and bytes preserved.
benchmark_stability.latest_result: Warmed normal ln is 6.984375 versus 7.43310546875 us; normalized ln 7.17041015625 versus 7.162109375 us. Earlier 18% normal-ln headline based on transient reference timing is superseded.
benchmark_stability.required_next_check: All98 groups and a predefined reversed-order repeat of eight close groups completed. Retain the raw medians and small-margin caveat; remeasure if production math or layout changes.

physical_warmed_ln_cube_v4.method: Both implementations in flash; identical input order, nine alternating paired batches, TIMERAWL, typed soft-float calls and matching calibration leaves. Interrupts enabled. XIP hit/access counters sampled outside timing; include both cores, with paired control counts recorded. Owned math addresses and bytes match production; Qfplib is isolated at 0x10180000. Both libraries warm up inside the APP for at least 1000000 us before timing.
physical_warmed_ln_cube_v4.interpretation: Warmed atan takes about 13.8% less time and normal-exponent ln about 6.0% less time. The normalized ln difference is about 0.12% slower and unresolved at this precision. Sqrt takes about 1.1-1.7% less time in this run; repeat before declaring the small margin settled. Exp small-range and tan qfplib-range still take about 3% more time.
physical_warmed_ln_cube_v4.scope: Seven selected workloads, one warmed hardware run; not a complete final 98-group qualification.

experimental_pow_interval.description: Independent directed base-2^16 fixed-point log/exp, exact rational ln2, complete dyadic-boundary recognition and same-cell RNE packing. The prototype computes the magnitude after normal pow domain/sign handling; private caller tests apply the sign.
experimental_pow_interval.limitation: The512/1024-bit result is accepted only if an enclosure fits a single rounding cell. A larger fixed precision does not prove totality; a sound complete fallback and feasible MCU resource plan are still required.
experimental_pow_interval.scope: Every source and binary is private under .build. Production EFDBF610 math source hashes remain unchanged and the current performance measurements apply only to that production candidate.
